name: Ricercar
description: Fantasia: a visual fantasia set to music. A fugue is repetition with variation, so the drawing answers itself — a note ATTACK in the music births a small luminous gestural mark, which echoes and imitates itself as the music repeats, over a soft painterly colour-shifting ground. Marks fire ONLY on real note onsets, never on a timer or a sustain-fill, which is what keeps the drawing locked to what is actually being played. Each mark's colour is the instrument SECTION playing it (PANNs family activity, D-177/IFC.4) and its FORM is the articulation: legato a long flowing line, staccato a short clip, pizzicato a dot. See docs/presets/RICERCAR_DESIGN.md. RICERCAR-ECHO; wired into the app at RICERCAR-WIRE.1, replacing the FL.10 particle flow-field.
author: Matt
